issue.title: Bug: test_route_perf: reload_dut fixture crashes with AttributeError when rep_call is missing

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The reload_dut fixture is an autouse=True teardown fixture. After yield, it accesses request.node.rep_call.failed to decide whether to config-reload the DUT. The problem is that rep_call is only set by the pytest_runtest_makereport hook after the test call phase completes. If the fixture teardown runs in a scenario where rep_call hasn't been attached yet (e.g., the test was skipped, collection failed, or an error occurred during setup), accessing request.node.rep_call raises an AttributeError, masking a real failure.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/af3dde7d701145173a47061a2d086c1e6acfdeee/tests/route/test_route_perf.py#L152-L158

### Steps to Reproduce

If any of the dependent fixture fails, this error can be reproduced.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior:

When test_perf_add_remove_routes fails during the setup phase (e.g., DUT unreachable, fixture error, or test skipped), the reload_dut teardown crashes with:

AttributeError: 'Function' object has no attribute 'rep_call'

This results in:
- The original setup failure / skip reason is masked in the test report by the AttributeError
- The config_reload cleanup is never evaluated — if it was actually needed, the DUT is left in a dirty state
- Test report shows an ERROR in teardown instead of the real root cause, making triage harder

Expected behavior:

When the test never reaches the call phase, the reload_dut teardown should exit gracefully without error. Specifically:

- If rep_call is not present (test was skipped or failed in setup), the fixture should assume no config reload is needed and return silently
- The original failure / skip reason should be the only error visible in the test report
- No secondary AttributeError should appear in teardown

### Relevant log output

```shell
AttributeError: 'Function' object has no attribute 'rep_call'
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

resolution.title: Fix `reload_dut` AttributeError when test skips or fails in setup
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
The `reload_dut` fixture in `tests/route/test_route_perf.py` unconditionally accesses `request.node.rep_call.failed` during teardown. The `rep_call` attribute is only set by the `pytest_runtest_makereport` hook (in `tests/conftest.py`)
after the call phase completes. When a test is skipped or fails during setup, `rep_call` is never set, causing an `AttributeError` that masks the original failure.

This PR adds a `hasattr` guard so the teardown exits gracefully when the test never reaches the call phase

Fixes #23756

### Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [ ] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [x] Test case improvement

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
When `test_perf_add_remove_routes` fails during setup or is skipped, the `reload_dut` fixture teardown crashes with:
AttributeError: 'Function' object has no attribute 'rep_call'
This secondary error masks the real root cause in the test report and may leave the DUT in a dirty state.

#### How did you do it?
Added a `hasattr(request.node, "rep_call")` guard before accessing `request.node.rep_call.failed`

#### How did you verify/test it?
- Verified the fix by triggering a setup-phase failure (unreachable DUT) and confirming the teardown completes without `AttributeError`.
- Confirmed that the `config_reload` path still executes correctly when `rep_call` is present and `failed` is `True`.
